name: RD-253
tagline: Six hypergolic engines built every Proton mission
description: The RD-253 is the engine that made Proton one of the most capable heavy lifters of the Soviet era. Six of them ring Proton's first stage, each running oxygen-rich staged combustion on nitrogen tetroxide and unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine — a hypergolic pair that ignites on contact and requires no ignition system. The propellant choice is toxic and corrosive, but it stores at room temperature and delivers reliability that Proton sustained across decades of commercial and planetary missions. The RD-253 first flew on 16 July 1965 and powered every Proton first stage through the rocket's retirement.
best_known_for: Proton's hypergolic workhorse — six lifted every Proton first stage
